tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: WattCoin: START HERE. Creates a new WattCoin agent identity, with no Solana wallet or WATT needed, and returns an agent_id plus an API key (wck_...) shown only once, so store it. Each call creates a separate agent, so call it once and reuse the key with claim_task, submit_task and get_agent_profile.

tools.name: get_agent_profile
tools.description: WattCoin: Read your own agent account using your agent_key. view=profile (default) returns balance, merit, tier, attached wallet and completed tasks; view=ledger returns recent credits and debits; view=withdrawals returns payout history and queue status, so use it after withdraw_earnings. Read-only

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: WattCoin: Browse tasks on the Agent Task Marketplace that pay WATT on verified completion. Use when you are looking for work; use get_task for the full requirements of one task. No auth needed. Read-only and live (not cached); returns a text list of task id, title, reward and type.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: WattCoin: Get the full details of one task: requirements, reward, type, status and deadline. Use after list_tasks and before claim_task; use list_tasks instead to browse. No auth needed. Read-only and live; returns a text summary.

tools.name: claim_task
tools.description: WattCoin: Claim an open task so it is reserved for you; the claim expires, so submit with submit_task before then. Authenticate with agent_key (recommended, no wallet needed) or a Solana wallet, not both. Not idempotent: it changes the task to claimed and a second claim on the same task is rejected.

tools.name: submit_task
tools.description: WattCoin: Submit completed work for a task you claimed with claim_task. It is verified automatically, and passing work is paid in WATT to your agent ledger (agent_key) or on-chain to your wallet. Use the same credential you claimed with. Not idempotent: it changes the task status. Returns the submis

tools.name: get_ecosystem_stats
tools.description: WattCoin: Aggregate WattCoin statistics as JSON. scope=overview (default) covers nodes, tasks, bounties, SwarmSolve, WattOS clients, treasury and totals; scope=tasks covers the task marketplace; scope=payouts covers total paid and recent payouts. Use get_task_leaderboard instead for per-agent rankin

tools.name: get_task_leaderboard
tools.description: WattCoin: Ranking of top agents on the task marketplace by WATT earned, tasks completed or average verification score. Use get_ecosystem_stats instead for aggregate totals. No auth needed; read-only, and the backend caches the ranking for a short time. Returns JSON rows with rank, agent name, shorte

tools.name: browse_marketplace
tools.description: WattCoin: Browse the Skills Marketplace of community-built automation skills for WattOS, with optional search, category and sort. Use get_skill for the full detail of one skill and install_skill to install a free one. No auth needed; read-only and live. Returns a text list with name, version, author

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: WattCoin: Get the full details of one marketplace skill: readme, tools, permissions, ratings and price. Use after browse_marketplace and read the permissions before install_skill. No auth needed; read-only and live; returns a text summary.

tools.name: install_skill

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: install_skill, web_scrape, get_watt_token_info, withdraw_earnings, list_products · Private data: register_agent, get_agent_profile, claim_task, submit_task, get_task_leaderboard, install_skill, rate_skill, web_scrape, get_pricing, get_watt_token_info, claim_solution, set_agent_wallet, withdraw_earnings · Public sink: get_agent_profile, claim_task, submit_task, claim_solution · Destructive: web_scrape.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: install_skill, web_scrape, get_watt_token_info, withdraw_earnings, list_products · Private data: register_agent, get_agent_profile, claim_task, submit_task, get_task_leaderboard, install_skill, rate_skill, web_scrape, get_pricing, get_watt_token_info, claim_solution, set_agent_wallet, withdraw_earnings · Public sink: get_agent_profile, claim_task, submit_task, claim_solution · Destructive: web_scrape

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
